subheader: An icon, the guarantee in a line or two, and up to four supporting points.
lead: The points are where the limits go — how long, on what, who decides — because a guarantee whose conditions live on another page has to be trusted twice.
note: The note holds the mechanics: who to ask, how, and how long the answer takes.

points.title: When it starts and ends
points.text: A period with a stated beginning is a promise; one without is a mood.

points.title: What exactly it covers
points.text: And, just as usefully, what it does not.

points.title: What the reader keeps
points.text: The part a guarantee usually forgets to mention.

points.title: How to claim it
points.text: One sentence. If claiming needs a diagram, the promise is smaller than it looks.
